title: A3 Kaizen — reduce deployment lead time (LeanStyle)
description: Story: a Lean A3 problem-solving cycle on deployment lead time. The current state measures 6 hours end-to-end; the target is 30 minutes. Three Requirements capture the PDCA triad: Problem-Statement (the gap), Countermeasure (the change), Standard-Work (the new baseline). Each maps to a Feature exercising the kaizen loop. Eight ACs total, measured at unit/functional/perf levels. Demonstrates LeanStyle: Toyota/A3/Gemba vocabulary, value-stream fit criteria, standard-work artifacts.

requirements.title: Standard work: new deploy playbook, daily Gemba walk

features.title: Measure current state — VSM of deployment pipeline
Apply countermeasure — parallel build + dep cache
Lock in gains — standard work + daily Gemba

narration.intro: A3 Kaizen — LeanStyle demo. Deploy lead time 6h -> 30min via PDCA.
narration.outro: Standard work in place, Gemba walks scheduled. Gains locked in.
